title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file
description: patch_file was called twice with pure-insertion diffs (no removed lines) on .github/workflows/release.yml. Both attempts failed with 'error applying hunk #1'. Recovered via write_file. Kernel recorded both failures as tool errors, causing tool-errors rubric to fail.
proposed_resolution: Fix patch_file.rs to correctly apply hunks where orig_count is 0, or update run.skill.md to direct agents to use write_file for pure-insertion changes.

title: patch_file does not support pure-insertion unified diffs
description: Two patch_file calls with pure-insertion diffs (only + lines and context, no - removed lines, orig_count=0) both failed with 'error applying hunk #1'. Forces agents to fall back to write_file for simple insertions.
proposed_resolution: Fix patch_file.rs to apply hunks where orig_count is 0. The relocate_hunk_positions step should anchor on following context lines when no preceding context exists.

title: run.skill.md should direct agents to use write_file for pure-insertion changes
description: Phase 3 of run.skill.md instructs agents to prefer patch_file for changes under ~20 lines but does not distinguish pure insertions (no removed lines) from modifications. Two tool errors were incurred before falling back to write_file.
proposed_resolution: Add a note to Phase 3 of run.skill.md: if the change is a pure insertion (no lines removed), use write_file instead of patch_file.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (start_run result file)
description: Used Read (Claude Code built-in) 3 times to read the oversized start_run output saved to an absolute host path. The moeb read_file tool only reads relative paths from the project working directory.
proposed_resolution: Extend start_run to return large content via a moeb-accessible relative path, or add a moeb tool for reading kernel-generated output files by run_id.

title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch (deferred schema loading)
description: ToolSearch called 4 times to load deferred MCP tool schemas before implementation could begin. No moeb equivalent exists for loading deferred tool schemas. Causes moeb-tool-origin to fail on every run.
proposed_resolution: Pre-include required tool schemas in start_run output, or introduce a schema-preload mechanism that eliminates ToolSearch calls during moeb runs.
